<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-farm
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 kalika-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer dupcheshwar-market adult 1
defer uttargaya-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 74

This rescues the 3 adults at Kalika farm, the only group that's cheap to reach (14 driving minutes round trip to save 60 in penalties). Rescuing the other 3 adults would require the car to go through Dupcheshwar market to Uttargaya farm and back, about 110 minutes, to save only 60 in penalties, so the total would be 124 instead of 74. The Dupcheshwar adult alone costs 64 minutes round trip to save 20, which isn't worth it either.
